title: Deep learning drug-response model nominates obatoclax for colorectal liver metastasis
summary: Two prognostic signatures were derived from differentially expressed genes in colorectal liver metastasis, and an interpretable deep learning model trained on drug sensitivity databases was used to find drugs for high-risk patients. Obatoclax, a BCL-2 inhibitor, showed different predicted responses between risk groups and was effective in Transwell assays and in a CT26 colorectal liver metastasis mouse model. The abstract does not name the deep learning architecture or give effect sizes.
ai_technology: Interpretable deep learning drug-response model (architecture not named in the abstract)

evidence.tested: In vitro Transwell assays and a CT26 mouse model of colorectal liver metastasis.
evidence.unknown: Architecture and effect sizes not stated in the abstract; mouse model only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model predicted drug sensitivity and pointed to obatoclax for high-risk patients.
